units.locator: Article 23.91. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Operation of the State System for Detecting, Preventing and Eliminating the Consequences of Computer Attacks on the Information Resources of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority authorised in the field of ensuring the operation of the state system for detecting, preventing and eliminating the consequences of computer attacks on the information resources of the Russian Federation shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 2 and 3 of Article 13.12.1, Article 13.12.2, and part 2 of Article 19.7.15 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.91

units.locator: Article 23.91. Federal Executive Authority Authorised in the Field of Ensuring the Operation of the State System for Detecting, Preventing and Eliminating the Consequences of Computer Attacks on the Information Resources of the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. The head of the federal executive authority authorised in the field of ensuring the operation of the state system for detecting, preventing and eliminating the consequences of computer attacks on the information resources of the Russian Federation, his or her deputies, heads of structural divisions of that federal executive authority, their deputies, heads of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority, their deputies, and heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of that federal executive authority shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.91

units.locator: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts
units.text: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts

Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) over the activities of professional debt collection organisations and credit and microfinance organisations included in the list of credit and microfinance organisations engaged in the recovery of individuals' overdue debts shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.57 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.92

units.locator: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.92

units.locator: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) over the activities of professional debt collection organisations and credit and microfinance organisations included in the list of credit and microfinance organisations engaged in the recovery of individuals' overdue debts and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.92

units.locator: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts
units.text: 2) the head of the structural division of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) over the activities of professional debt collection organisations and credit and microfinance organisations included in the list of credit and microfinance organisations engaged in the recovery of individuals' overdue debts and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.92

units.locator: Article 23.92. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Control (Supervision) over the Activities of Professional Debt Collection Organisations and Credit and Microfinance Organisations Included in the List of Credit and Microfinance Organisations Engaged in the Recovery of Individuals' Overdue Debts
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state control (supervision) over the activities of professional debt collection organisations and credit and microfinance organisations included in the list of credit and microfinance organisations engaged in the recovery of individuals' overdue debts and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.92

units.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System
units.text: 1. Authorities exercising control (supervision) functions in the sphere of circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means, using the monitoring information system, shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Articles 15.12.1 and 15.12.2 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.93

units.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.93

units.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System
units.text: 1) heads of federal executive authorities exercising control (supervision) functions in the sphere of circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means, using the monitoring information system, and their deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.93

units.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of federal executive authorities exercising control (supervision) functions in the sphere of circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means, using the monitoring information system, and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.93

units.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities exercising control (supervision) functions in the sphere of circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means, using the monitoring information system, and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.93

units.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System
units.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of federal executive authorities exercising control (supervision) functions in the sphere of circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means, using the monitoring information system, and their deputies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.93

units.locator: Article 23.93. Authorities Exercising Control (Supervision) Functions in the Sphere of Circulation of Goods Subject to Mandatory Marking with Identification Means, Using the Monitoring Information System
units.text: 5) heads of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising control (supervision) functions in the sphere of circulation of goods subject to mandatory marking with identification means, using the monitoring information system, and their deputies.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.93

units.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision

units.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state assay supervision shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 15.27 (within its powers), Article 15.43, parts 2 and 3 of Article 15.44, Articles 15.46 and 15.47, part 8 of Article 19.4 and part 43 of Article 19.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.94

units.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.94

units.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state assay supervision and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.94

units.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state assay supervision and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.94

units.locator: Article 23.94. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Assay Supervision
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state assay supervision and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.94

units.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use
units.text: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use
units.label: Art. 23.95

units.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use
units.label: Art. 23.95

units.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of natural resource use shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 8.52 (within its powers) and part 1 of Article 8.54 (within its powers) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.95

units.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled, within their powers, to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.95

units.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of natural resource use and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.95

units.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of natural resource use and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.95

units.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of natural resource use and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.95

units.locator: Article 23.95. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Control and Supervision Functions in the Sphere of Natural Resource Use
units.text: 4) heads of departments, deputy heads of departments and other officials of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising control and supervision functions in the sphere of natural resource use.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.95

units.locator: Article 23.96. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Treatment of Animals

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.96. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Treatment of Animals
units.label: Art. 23.96

units.locator: Article 23.96. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Treatment of Animals
units.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the field of treatment of animals shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by part 1, part 2 (within their powers) and part 3 of Article 8.52, and Article 8.54 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.96

units.locator: Article 23.96. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Field of Treatment of Animals
units.text: 2. Heads of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, their deputies, heads of structural divisions of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and their deputies shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.96

units.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
units.text: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
units.label: Art. 23.97

units.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
units.label: Art. 23.97

units.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.43 and Articles 14.44, 14.45 and 14.46 of this Code where those offences involve violation of the requirements of the technical regulation of the Eurasian Economic Union 'On the Safety of Products Intended for Civil Defence and Protection against Natural and Man-Made Emergencies' (TR EAEU 050/2021), and by parts 1 - 4 of Article 14.46.2 of this Code (with respect to products intended for civil defence and protection against natural and man-made emergencies).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.97

units.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authority specified in part 1 of this Article:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.97

units.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
units.text: 1) the deputy head — Chief State Inspector of the Russian Federation for Fire Supervision — of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.97

units.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.97

units.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies and their deputies;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.97

units.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
units.text: 4) heads of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies and their deputies;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 23.97

units.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
units.text: 5) heads of territorial departments (divisions, inspectorates) of structural divisions of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies and their deputies;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 23.97

units.locator: Article 23.97. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision in the Field of Civil Defence and Federal State Supervision in the Field of Protection of the Population and Territories against Emergencies
units.text: 6) officials of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies, and of its territorial authorities, who are authorised to exercise federal state supervision in the field of civil defence and federal state supervision in the field of protection of the population and territories against emergencies.
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 23.97

units.locator: Article 23.98. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Tourism Industry
units.text: Article 23.98. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Tourism Industry
units.label: Art. 23.98

units.locator: Article 23.98. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Tourism Industry
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.98. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Tourism Industry
units.label: Art. 23.98

units.locator: Article 23.98. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Tourism Industry
units.text: 1. Executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising regional state control (supervision) in the tourism industry shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.39, parts 11 - 15 (except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas), parts 16 - 19 and parts 20 and 21 (except administrative offences committed in specially protected natural areas) of Article 14.51, and part 1 of Article 19.5 (within their powers) of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.98

units.locator: Article 23.98. Executive Authorities of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation Exercising Regional State Control (Supervision) in the Tourism Industry
units.text: 2. Heads of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, their deputies, heads of structural divisions of the respective executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, their deputies, and heads of state institutions subordinate to executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorised to exercise regional state control (supervision) in the tourism industry (where the exercise of regional state control (supervision) in the tourism industry is entrusted to such state institutions) shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the authorities specified in part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.98

units.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers
units.text: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers

units.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers
units.label: Art. 23.99

units.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers
units.text: 1. The federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of valuers shall hear cases concerning administrative offences provided for by Article 14.71 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23.99

units.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers
units.text: 2. The following shall be entitled to hear cases concerning administrative offences on behalf of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of valuers:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23.99

units.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers
units.text: 1) the head of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of valuers and his or her deputies;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23.99

units.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers
units.text: 2) heads of structural divisions of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of valuers and their deputies;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23.99

units.locator: Article 23.99. Federal Executive Authority Exercising Federal State Supervision Functions over the Activities of Self-Regulatory Organisations of Valuers
units.text: 3) heads of territorial authorities of the federal executive authority exercising federal state supervision functions over the activities of self-regulatory organisations of valuers and their deputies.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23.99
